# Direct results from nested instance producers

Owned generic forwarders call both ExecutorService.invokeAny overloads and an
independent Worker interface. One method formal connects a Collection of Callable
values to the direct result. Frozen direct, separately compiled caller, reflection
and MethodHandle paths observe exact receiver and argument identities, wide
contexts, interrupt state, checked exception/cause identities and delayed caller
casts. Source and SDK profiles compile every recovered source and retain original
metadata. Thirteen independently compiled wrong programs and eight same-Code
Signature changes qualify the observers and rejection boundary.
